params.caption: Birinchi darsdan keyin bir talaba: "Ustoz, bu zamonlarni hech tushunolmasam kerak". Ustoz kulib: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it. Get the hang of something biror ishni mashq qilib-qilib, asta-sekin eplab ketishni bildiradi. O'zbekchada "qo'l o'rganib qoldi", "ko'nikib qoldim" deganimizga juda yaqin. Undan keyin ot yoki -ing shakl keladi: I'm finally getting the hang of the Present Perfect, nihoyat Present Perfectni tushunib olyapman. It took me a month to get the hang of IELTS Writing Task 1, Writing Task 1ga ko'nikishim uchun bir oy kerak bo'ldi. She got the hang of driving very quickly, u mashina haydashni juda tez o'rganib oldi.
